description: Read recorded consent rates and recent consent receipts for the requested authorized workspace. Output schema_version 2 replaces country breakdowns and the country daily dimension with geography (country, US state or Canadian province/territory). Rates cover recorded choices, not unique visitors, over 180 days; geography and language breakdowns and their daily series show the top 50 values by recorded choices. An independent policy_class breakdown includes Policy not recorded for NULL history. Recent receipts include banner_version, raw country, nullable region and policy_class, geography and geography_label. This tool does not change data or call advertising APIs.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.
